headline: Energy Ministry mandates citizens to visualize solar power to reduce oil imports
body:
The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas has officially launched a nationwide 'Imagination Initiative,' urging citizens to eliminate the country's crude oil dependence by simply thinking about cleaner energy alternatives for at least four hours every day. The department suggests that if enough people mentally project a transition to hydrogen and solar, the global market price for barrels will eventually become a redundant concept.

'We have identified that the primary bottleneck in our energy security is not infrastructure or global supply chains, but a collective lack of intellectual ambition toward oil-free living,' said Joint Secretary of Metaphysical Resources, Mr. Anirudh Varma. 'By shifting our mindset from fossil fuels to pure aspiration, we expect to see a 15% reduction in refinery imports by the next fiscal quarter, purely through the power of positive contemplation.'

To facilitate this, the government plans to distribute meditation mats featuring diagrams of wind turbines to all households. Officials clarified that while actual power generation is not an immediate requirement, maintaining a strong 'energy-independent mindset' during rush hour traffic is mandatory. The government hopes this cognitive shift will render tankers obsolete before the end of the decade.
caption: The government's new 'Think Green' policy is here. Just close your eyes and imagine the petrol price is zero. #EnergyRevolution #MindOverMatter #SelfReliance (satire)
